lines.name: l1
lines.text: This is how gummy bears are made.

lines.name: l2
lines.text: Sugar, glucose syrup and water get cooked. Then gelatin, color and flavor go in.

lines.name: l3
lines.text: A machine called a starch mogul stamps thousands of tiny bear shapes into trays of cornstarch.

lines.name: l4
lines.text: The hot mix is poured in, and the bears rest overnight while the starch pulls out the moisture.

lines.name: l5
lines.text: Then they're shaken out, brushed, and lightly coated so they don't stick together.
